owner_request: 2026-08-26 conversation: Owner asked to find 9,000 more candidates using the same standard as the delivered 1,000, allow a wider date range, and move the displayed vertical line three 15-minute bars earlier. Owner also asked to continue into dataset construction and 3060 training. Repository P0/P1 gates still require per-sample Owner confirmation before any candidate may become a training positive, so this preregistration authorizes candidate expansion and a review-only t-3 marker, but not automatic labels, training, holdout access, promotion, deployment or trading.

changes: extend scan_start from 2024-05-04 to 2022-01-03 while keeping the same pre-holdout end
display a review-only marker at selection t-3 while preserving selection t
authorized_multi_variable_bundle.unchanged: Dense-start morphology, causal formation gate, completed 12-bar ranking, review horizon, scoring weights, same-symbol/side 224-bar exclusion and candidate-not-label semantics remain frozen.

question: Can the frozen six-MA dense-start morphology add 9,000 balanced, diverse, non-overlapping pre-holdout 15-minute completed-shape candidates to the existing 1,000-candidate review pool without changing what qualifies as a candidate?
candidate_not_label_contract: Every new row is PENDING. A machine proposal, a favorable completed path, or a uniformly shifted review marker is not an Owner-confirmed positive, is not a YOLO box and is not training eligible.

existing_candidate_exclusion.use: Seed same-symbol/side exclusion intervals and symbol/day counts before selecting the 9,000 additions. The prior manifest remains byte-identical and is not relabeled or rerendered.

scope.universe_rule: Choose the largest declared-row okx_*_USDT_SWAP_15m_*.csv per symbol across both roots; on equal row counts prefer kline_deep; exclude BLOCKED_BASES, stockish symbols and the frozen eval-symbol manifest.
scope.boundary_read_rule: Read chronological CSV lines only until the first timestamp at or after holdout_start. The boundary timestamp may be inspected, but its OHLCV cells must never be converted, materialized, hashed, charted or scored.

frozen_dependencies.profile_reuse_limit: The profile was selected in an ETH pre-holdout paper experiment and is reused only as the same broad proposal gate used by the delivered 1,000-candidate pool. Its prior economic result is not transferred.
frozen_dependencies.atr_semantics: Pine/Wilder RMA14 with SMA seed, matching the inherited dense-start experiment. This descriptive use does not resolve or change the repository's separate execution-ATR dispute.

shape_contract.causal_proposal_bar: At completed bar t, formation features use [t-12,t-1]; release features may use t; no proposal feature reads t+1 or later.
shape_contract.review_marker_semantics: The blue line is drawn at selection t-3 only to implement the Owner's requested visual review shift. The original selection t remains visible as an orange dashed line and remains the only candidate anchor. The blue line is not a training label, box boundary or causal-signal claim.
shape_contract.review_only_future_physical_separation: Only results/review_charts is generated. No training image or YOLO label is generated in this run.

ranking.clipping: Each future component is direction-signed, divided by its fixed ATR reference and clipped to [0,1]. No post-scan threshold fitting is permitted.
ranking.tie_break: completed_score descending, then symbol ascending, then anchor_time ascending

selection.quota_basis: The delivered pool capped each symbol and UTC day at 8 of 500 candidates per side (1.6%). The combined 10,000-candidate pool therefore caps each at 80 of 5,000 per side, preserving the same maximum share. Prior rows seed these union-pool counts.
selection.fail_closed: If either direction cannot supply 4,500 additions after all exclusions, deduplication and union-pool quotas, write no candidate gallery and do not relax any rule.

controls.causality_null: For a deterministic sample of selected rows, mutate every row after t and recompute. Every causal proposal feature and gate decision through t must remain exactly identical.
controls.duplicate_null: Across the old 1,000 plus new 9,000, no selected pair on the same symbol and side may be within 224 bars.
controls.quota_null: Across the old 1,000 plus new 9,000, no symbol or UTC day may exceed 80 rows per side.
controls.existing_label_manifest_read: Forbidden in this collection run. The hash-pinned prior candidate manifest is an unlabeled PENDING exclusion pool, not an Owner gold-label manifest.
controls.economic_metrics: Not applicable: this run defines no entry, exit, cost, TP/SL or model score.

downstream_gate.training_window_contract_to_recover: Use the repository's Owner-approved Local Signal V2 lineage: approximately 14-22 bars of shortest sufficient context, 4-7 core bars, 3 preferred and 5 maximum confirmation bars, naturally varying box position, and original Owner geometry rather than a global shift.
downstream_gate.negative_contract_to_recover: Only after accepted positive boxes exist: same-symbol/time-block isolated negatives, full Owner-box exclusion zones, no cross-split temporal leakage, and the previous 3:1 train-negative ratio with easy and hard negatives tracked separately.
downstream_gate.training_blocker: Do not materialize training labels or start 3060 training until Owner per-sample verdicts and box geometry make a P0/P1 Gold Dataset training-eligible.
